We need answer only JSON object with declaration, implementation, supporting_objects. Need implement FB_Task CODESYS ST. Need exact interface names/types. Need include VAR sections in declaration (no END_FUNCTION_BLOCK). implementation ST body alone. supporting_objects list helper DUT/POU objects each name kind declaration implementation; functions need return_type. Need define referenced DUTs. We can likely no supporting objects or maybe enum? Interface Phase USINT. Need implement behavior.

Need ensure declaration includes "FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task" then VAR sections. Inputs Enable BOOL, Tick BOOL; outputs Red Green Amber BOOL, Phase USINT. Internal vars phase state and elapsed. Could use VAR ... END_VAR. Need declaration string includes all VAR sections. Omit END_FUNCTION_BLOCK. Need implementation body.

Behavior: initialization phase RED elapsed 0. With Enable FALSE force RED and clear elapsed every scan. With Enable TRUE and Tick FALSE retain phase and elapsed. TRUE Tick adds one; upon reaching phase duration transition RED->GREEN->AMBER->RED and clear elapsed ticks. Output Phase 0,1,2 and exactly one color describes post-transition phase. Tick level per invocation not rising edge.

Need decide internal state variable names. We need exact task interface names. Add internal `_phase : USINT := 0; _elapsed : USINT := 0;` maybe. In CODESYS, FB VAR initialized at declaration? CODESYS allows initialization in VAR. Need initialization on reset? "At initialization set phase RED and elapsed ticks zero." Declaration initializers okay. But if instance reset, vars initialized. Could also handle first scan? Not required. Need robust.

Important scan semantics: sample inputs once, read retained pre-state, execute one transition, observe outputs same scan. Our code reads Enable/Tick and updates internal output vars at end. Need output Phase post-transition. On initial state _phase=0, _elapsed=0. Tick TRUE and Enable TRUE: increment to 1; phase RED duration 2. Since 1 <2 no transition => Phase 0, Red true. Then next Tick FALSE retains. Next Tick TRUE: increment to 2; reaches duration => transition to GREEN, elapsed=0; Phase 1, Green true. Matches test. Good.

Need disable: force RED clear elapsed every scan, phase 0. Even if Tick true no increment. Good.

Need code structure:

IF NOT Enable THEN
    _phase := 0;
    _elapsed := 0;
ELSIF Tick THEN
    _elapsed := _elapsed + 1;
    CASE _phase OF
        0: IF _elapsed >= 2 THEN _phase := 1; _elapsed := 0; END_IF
        1: IF _elapsed >= 3 THEN _phase := 2; _elapsed := 0; END_IF
        2: IF _elapsed >= 1 THEN _phase := 0; _elapsed := 0; END_IF
        ELSE
            _phase := 0; _elapsed := 0;
    END_CASE
END_IF

Then set outputs based on _phase:
Phase := _phase;
Red := (_phase = 0);
Green := (_phase = 1);
Amber := (_phase = 2);

Need concern CODESYS ST syntax for assigning bool expression: Red := (_phase = 0); okay. USINT comparison to integer okay. `_elapsed >= 2` okay. Could use `_elapsed := _elapsed + 1;` overflow not issue.

Need maybe when Enable false, Tick ignored. Good.

Need "With Enable TRUE and Tick FALSE retain phase and elapsed ticks." Our ELSIF Tick only increments; no change otherwise. Good.

Need exactly one color. If invalid _phase else resets on tick only; but if Enable true Tick false and _phase invalid due memory? internal initialized. okay. On disable phase 0. Outputs one-hot.

Need declaration includes `VAR_INPUT`, `VAR_OUTPUT`, `VAR` maybe with initializers. Example:

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task
VAR_INPUT
    Enable : BOOL;
    Tick : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    Red : BOOL;
    Green : BOOL;
    Amber : BOOL;
    Phase : USINT;
END_VAR
VAR
    _phase : USINT := 0;
    _elapsed : USINT := 0;
END_VAR

Need "declaration is CODESYS FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task followed by all VAR sections; omit END_FUNCTION_BLOCK." That string.

Implementation body alone. Could include comments? Fine. No markdown. Need JSON escape newlines.

Supporting_objects: likely empty list because no referenced DUTs? But task says Define referenced DUTs. We don't reference any DUTs. Could define enum? Not needed. The interface uses only standard types. So supporting_objects [].

Need final JSON only. Ensure valid JSON. Use strings with \n. No markdown. Let's craft.

Need maybe include `return_type`? Only functions need return_type; no functions. supporting_objects empty.

Potential issue: In CODESYS, variable declarations initialized in VAR may not reset when online reset? They do on download/reset. Fine. Could implement first-scan init with `_initialized`? Not necessary. But maybe "At initialization" and tests reset instance before each. Declaration initializers suffice. But if retaining? okay.

Need maybe internal variables named with leading underscore accepted? CODESYS allows underscore. Good.

Need output assignment after state transition. If Enable FALSE, output Red true. Good.

Could use `CASE _phase OF` with `0:` etc. CODESYS ST CASE requires `0: ...;` and `END_CASE`. `ELSE` allowed. Good.

Need consider `_elapsed := _elapsed + 1;` USINT max 255, durations small. No issue, reset when reaches. If pause for many ticks? only increments when Tick true. If Tick true continuously, resets at durations. No overflow.

Need ensure when Tick true in phase 0 and elapsed pre=1, increment=2 transition. Good. When pre elapsed maybe 0 and duration 2. Good.

Need maybe "Tick is enable level per invocation" means if Tick true every scan, counts each. Our does.

Need no supporting objects.

Let's final as JSON. Need include declaration string exactly with newline. Implementation string. Supporting_objects [].

Check JSON escaping: newlines as \n. Quotes none. Could include tabs? no.

Need return ONLY JSON object. Final.
